concept: Managing emotional reactions in the moment before they take over a decision
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a scenario that triggers a strong emotional reaction (embarrassment, anger, disappointment) right before needing to make a decision
exercise.branching_choice: Student chooses how to respond in the heated moment versus after a pause
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what a brief pause changed about the eventual decision

assessment.success_marker: student describes a specific, real difference between an immediate reaction and a paused response
